what: A wave band lies between sections — two 683%-wide wave SVGs joined end to end flow straight left by one SVG length in window width × .008 + 30 seconds (41s at 1440), while bobbing up and down eight times over the same length (−10% ↔ 6%). Big waves in the middle and calm ones at both ends make it feel like the sea rolling in, and it pauses off screen. Set the band color (currentColor) to the next section’s background and pull it up over the previous section by the band height (margin-top −band height), and the wave covers the previous section as it continues. look: rotate is a wave hanging down from above

options.time: One rotation (s), default auto — window width × .008 + 30 (original formula)
options.look: If rotate, the wave hangs down from the top edge (a band covering the head of the next section) — the sway is also −16% ↔ −6%
options.--fx-height: Band height (% of width), default 5.86% (style or the consuming css)

from.where: index.html .tn-wave, eight lines between sections · above the Footer on subpages
from.note: The original uses two hand-drawn wave paths. The part bakes a new seamless wave from integer harmonics
